requested_changes.body:
Using OFFSET for batch pagination will degrade badly on large scans because each batch has to skip an increasingly large prefix (often O(n*n) overall). Should we consider keyset pagination instead (`id__gt` `last_id` with `order_by("id")`) to keep total cost O(n) and stable across batches. Like



```
while True:
      with rls_transaction(prowler_api_provider.tenant_id, using=READ_REPLICA_ALIAS):
          qs = Finding.objects.filter(scan_id=scan_id).order_by("id")
          if last_id is not None:
              qs = qs.filter(id__gt=last_id)

          findings_batch = list(
              qs.values(...fields... )[:BATCH_SIZE]
          )

          if not findings_batch:
              break

          last_id = findings_batch[-1]["id"]
          enriched_batch = _enrich_and_flatten_batch(findings_batch)

      if enriched_batch:
          yield enriched_batch
```
